idea-plugin.name: Extended Tool Windows UI
idea-plugin.description:
Extends the New UI tool window layout with additional options:
  • Horizontal top and bottom stripes — place tool window buttons in a horizontal row along the top or bottom edge instead of the vertical side bars.
  • Top-left and top-right placement — anchor tool windows to the upper corners, next to the existing left, right, and bottom anchors.
  • Tool window names in the sidebars — show names next to the icons, rendered vertically so they cost no extra editor width.
